title: Angler: quest counter, milestone rewards and the Journey's End Angler shop
player_outcome: The Angler tracks how many of his quests you have completed ('You've done 12 of my quests!'). Rewards improve at milestones, and he sells decorative fishing-themed furniture unlocked by your quest count.
design: PlayerState.AnglerQuests (int), saved in PlayerSave as AnglerQuests (added without a version bump). TownServices.TurnInFish increments it and raises AnglerQuestDone.
AnglerQuestParams.Rewards: each reward gains MinQuests and EveryQuests (for example a fishing pole at 5 and 10 quests), following Terraria's reward table (verify). Coins also scale with count.
ConditionContext.AnglerQuests is filled from the talking or local player in TownSystem.TownContext. Angler shop entries use {type:'anglerQuests', min:N}.
New decor tile objects: lifebuoy, ships_wheel, wall_anchor, treasure_map, seaweed_planter, pile_of_seashells, fish trophies (bass/trout/tuna plaques). Use the furniture/painting generators.
TownDialog: the Quest text includes the counter; a new Angler 'Shop' button appears once the shop has entries.
data_changes: angler rewards table with milestones; about 10 shop objects
verification: In game: turn in fish on successive days; the counter shows and the shop grows
risks: PlayerSave.cs is also edited by the equipment phase (slots, trash). Keep this edit to one property.
